name: Deepgram STT
description: Speech-to-text via Deepgram Nova-3. Lower latency + higher accuracy on English than Whisper; preferred when a key is available. Server-side only — no browser-side fallback. Reads the API key from plugins.deepgram.apiKey or the legacy DEEPGRAM_API_KEY env var. When uninstalled, the 'deepgram' option disappears from the STT provider dropdown.
